_readme: THE ONLY FILE YOU EDIT TO REUSE THIS SITE FOR ANOTHER CANDIDATE. Swap this + the palette in site/src/styles/tokens.css + content/*.md + content/facts.json. See REUSE.md.

candidate.pronoun_note: Campaign to confirm pronouns before any third-person copy is added. Current copy is written in first person or uses the candidate's name.

slogan_alternates: For the people of Mountain House.
A neighbor who already showed up.
campaign.one_sentence: Suresh Vuyyuru is a Mountain House dad, software engineer, farmer, Rotary volunteer, and founder of the Mountain House Sports & Recreation Club — running for City Council to keep showing up for the people who already know his work.
campaign.disclaimer_interim: Paid for by the campaign to elect Suresh Vuyyuru for Mountain House City Council 2026.

community.villages_note: Village list is seed-sourced; campaign to confirm the full current list. The volunteer form includes an 'Other / not sure' option so a wrong list never blocks a signup.

languages.note: Mountain House is a young, majority-Asian, family city. Language is the electorate, not decoration. Spanish ships at launch; the routing and string layer is built for the rest.
